chapters.title: BFS over whole sentences

frames.caption: BFS over whole sentences — O(S · L · P) time, O(S · L) extra space. Input: generate_sentences(synonyms=[['happy', 'joy'], ['joy', 'cheerful']], text='I am happy'). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
seen, queue = {text}, deque([text]) — seen = {'I am happy'}; queue = ['I am happy']
words = queue.popleft().split() — 'I am happy' taken from the front of queue; words = ['I', 'am', 'happy']
if nxt not in seen: → true (nxt = 'I am joy')

if nxt not in seen: → false (nxt = 'I am happy')
if nxt not in seen: → true (nxt = 'I am cheerful')
